Charter Space and Project Omega Eye Nuclear Power for Sat Insurance
summary:
The specialty space insurer and nuclear power firm will jointly assess how long-duration radioisotope systems could cut spacecraft loss rates and reshape mission
The post Charter Space and Project Omega Eye Nuclear Power for Sat Insurance appeared first on The Fintech Times.
content: Charter Space and Project Omega are teaming up to explore the use of nuclear power for satellite insurance. The specialty space insurer and the nuclear power firm will jointly evaluate how long-duration radioisotope systems can help reduce spacecraft loss rates and transform mission planning.

summary: BMO is introducing AI Agent Assist to help clients get faster answers and resolutions when they contact BMO's Virtual Connect contact centre about their credit card transactions.
content: BMO has launched a new AI agent named AI Agent Assist to improve customer service for credit card holders. The tool is designed to help clients get faster answers and resolutions when contacting the BMO Virtual Connect contact centre regarding their credit card transactions.

PayFacto intergrates Interac Konek digital wallet across merchant network
summary: Interac Corp. (Interac) today announced that PayFacto Payments Inc. (PayFacto), a Montreal-based leader in payment and hospitality technology, is integrating Konek across its merchant and partner networks in Canada, giving businesses the option to enable account-based payments alongside card-based payments.
content: PayFacto Payments Inc. is integrating the Interac Konek digital wallet across its merchant and partner networks in Canada. This collaboration allows businesses to offer account-based payment options alongside traditional card-based payments, expanding payment flexibility for merchants and customers alike.

NCR Atleos launches ATM for retailers
summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced AllTM, an ATM solution that helps US retailers transform the ATM from a traditional cash access point into a powerful driver of foot traffic, customer engagement and revenue growth through expanded capabilities.
content: NCR Atleos Corporation has announced the launch of AllTM, a new ATM solution designed specifically for US retailers. The system aims to transform traditional cash access points into tools for increasing foot traffic, boosting customer engagement, and driving revenue growth through expanded self-service financial capabilities.

title: KCB Tanzania integrates PayPal into mobile banking
summary: KCB Bank Tanzania has partnered with PayPal to integrate PayPal services into the KCB Mobile App, giving customers a simple, secure and convenient way to connect to global payments directly through their banking app.
content: KCB Bank Tanzania has partnered with PayPal to integrate PayPal services into the KCB Mobile App. This collaboration allows customers to easily and securely connect to global payments directly through their banking application, enhancing digital financial convenience for users in Tanzania.
